say:1:1322225001:1.text: Pendants, amulets, and personal medallions... Fortunately, there are still many items to prove their existence.
say:1:1322225001:1.source_cn: 吊坠、名牌……好在还有这么多东西可以证明他们的存在。

say:2:1322225002:1.text: Although I can't see their names very clearly on these items, maybe their family members and descendants may recognize them.
say:2:1322225002:1.source_cn: 虽然已经看不清名字了，但说不定还有能认出它们的家人。

say:3:1322225003:1.text: Some even carried their medals with them. They must've been very brave in battle.
say:3:1322225003:1.source_cn: 甚至还有人随身带着勋章，证明着他们曾经的赫赫战功！

say:4:1322225004:1.text: This medal was still on his chest when he died. It must have meant everything to him.
say:4:1322225004:1.source_cn: 这枚勋章在战死后都还贴在他的心口，一定是极为看重的。

say:5:1322225005:1.text: Let's bring this proof back to Carolina.
say:5:1322225005:1.source_cn: 我们快把这些证据带回给卡列琳娜吧！
